name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  rcases UpdateStatesUpdated hu ▸ InitStatesUpdated hi
  repeat constructor
  apply updatedStatesInit
  rotate_left
  apply UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' _ hu
  apply InitStatesNotDefined hi
  apply InitStatesNodup hi
  unfold updatedStates
  rewrite [updatedStatesComm]
  apply updatedStatesUpdate
  rotate_left
  apply updatedStatesDefMonotone
  apply UpdateStatesDefined' hu
  all_goals simp [List.unzip_zip, UpdateStatesLength hu, InitStatesLength hi]
  intro k hk hk'
  injection InitStatesNotDefined hi k hk' ▸ UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x
  false_or_by_contra
  rename_i hx
  have hc := Continuous.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (λ_ => f x) hf continuous_const
  have hp := real_inner_self_nonneg'.lt_of_ne' $ inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx
  obtain ⟨φ, hs, hk, hd, hn, hφ⟩ := exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset $ hc.continuousAt.eventually_const_lt hp
  refine' ((hd.continuous.fun_mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero hk.mul_right ?_ $ by rw [hφ, one_mul]; apply hp.ne').ne' $ by
    simpa only [inner_smul_right'] using hg _ $ IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨hd, hk⟩ contDiff_const
  intro y
  by_cases hy : y ∈ tsupport φ
  · apply mul_nonneg (Set.range_subset_iff.1 hn y).1 (hs hy).le
  · simp [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hy]

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hA3 : ContDiff ℝ (2+1) A := hA.of_le (by decide)
  have hJd := hJ.differentiable nofun
  have hBt (j : Fin d) := Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
    (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (c := 𝓕.c) A hA3 (j, i)) x
  have hBs := Differentiable.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) fun j _ => hBt j
  have hJt := LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (c := 𝓕.c) hJd x i
  have hEd (j k : Fin d) := Space.deriv_differentiable
    (electricField_apply_contDiff_space (c := 𝓕.c) (i := j) hA3 t) k
  have hJs := LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space (c := 𝓕.c) hJd t
  have hg := congrArg (fun f => ∂[i] f x)
    (funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time hA3.of_succ _),
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  rw [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub (hBs.const_mul _).differentiableAt
    (hJt.const_mul _).differentiableAt, fderiv_const_mul hBs.differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt, fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => (hBt j).differentiableAt]
  simp only [_root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, _root_.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← Time.deriv_eq, Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv
    (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff A hA3 _), time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ hA3.of_succ]
  simp only [Space.deriv_eq, div_eq_inv_mul] at hg
  unfold Space.div at hg
  simp only [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_fun] at hEd
  simp (disch := solve_by_elim only [hEd, hJs, Differentiable.differentiableAt]) only [Space.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub, fderiv_fun_sum,
    fderiv_const_mul, _root_.sub_apply, _root_.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hg ⊢
  simp only [← Space.deriv_eq, Space.deriv_commute (v := i) _
    (electricField_apply_contDiff_space hA3 t), Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at hg ⊢
  rw [hg]
  simp only [FreeSpace.c_sq, mul_inv_rev, div_eq_mul_inv]
  simp only [mul_right_comm (𝓕.μ₀⁻¹) (𝓕.ε₀⁻¹) 𝓕.μ₀, inv_mul_cancel₀ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero, one_mul]
  ring

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  suffices h : (mulLinearMap.comp (mulLinearMap.flip c)).compr₂ (ι.toLinearMap.comp timeOrderF) =
      mulLinearMap.compr₂ (ι.toLinearMap.comp ((mulLinearMap c).comp timeOrderF)) from
    congrArg (fun k => k a b) h
  apply LinearMap.ext_basis ofCrAnListFBasis ofCrAnListFBasis
  intro l r
  dsimp
  simp only [mulLinearMap_apply, ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
  have hs x y := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ l [x, y] r
  conv at hs =>
    intro x y h
    lhs
    rw [List.append_assoc]
    dsimp
  conv_lhs =>
    arg 2
    simp [c, superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, mul_sub, sub_mul,
      ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_append, List.append_assoc, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
    rw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, smul_comm, ← smul_sub]
    simp (disch := simp [hφψ, hψφ]) only [crAnTimeOrderList, hs,
      ofCrAnListF_append, ofCrAnListF_cons, ofCrAnListF_nil, mul_one]
    arg 2
    repeat rw [← smul_mul_assoc, ← sub_mul]
    repeat rw [← mul_smul_comm, ← mul_sub]
    rw [← smul_mul_assoc, ← superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
  conv_rhs =>
    rw [← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, crAnTimeOrderList, insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ l r]
  simp only [c, ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul ι, map_smul ι,
    Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
  simp only [mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, crAnTimeOrderSign]
  by_cases hq : 𝓕.crAnStatistics φ = 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ
  · rw [Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ hq.symm]
  · simp [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var => simp_all
  any_goals solve_by_elim
  case' app l _ _ _ => have := l.canonical_form_abs
  case' tapp d _ _ => have := d.canonical_form_tabs
  case' case d _ _ _ _ _ => have := d.canonical_form_sum
  all_goals repeat' first | simp_all only [body_let, body_case, true_implies] | casesm* And .., Or .., Exists .., Value (.inl _), Value (.inr _) <;> subst_vars | cases lc
  any_goals left; constructor; assumption
  all_goals right; solve_by_elim only [*, Exists.intro, Red.appᵣ, Red.abs, Red.tabs, Red.let_body, Red.case_inl, Red.case_inr, Red.case]

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a b c h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing c
  case refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  all_goals cases h₂
  case par.par ha hb iha ihb d e hc hd =>
    obtain ⟨_, hx⟩ := iha hc
    obtain ⟨_, hy⟩ := ihb hd
    exact ⟨_, .par hx.1 hy.1, .par hx.2 hy.2⟩
  all_goals
    try
      constructor
      constructor <;> constructor <;> assumption
  all_goals
    first
    | cases I_irreducible _ ‹_›
    | obtain ⟨_, h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ‹_›
    | obtain ⟨_, _, h, h', rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ‹_›
    constructor
    constructor
    all_goals
      try
        repeat' apply ParallelReduction.par
        all_goals assumption
    all_goals constructor

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro hpq
  exists _, ChoiceBisim.choice hpq
  rintro _ _ (h | h) _ <;> constructor <;> intro s t
  case' choice.left | choice.right => cases t
  case choiceR | choiceR => use s, Tr.choiceR ‹_›, ChoiceBisim.bisim (.refl s)
  all_goals
    apply Exists.imp fun _ => And.imp ?_ .bisim
    first | apply h.follow_fst | apply h.follow_snd
    assumption
    first | exact id | exact Tr.choiceL

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (Set.range_nonempty (fun g : BBF_Code 𝔽q β _ => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g.1).ncard))
  dsimp only at hg
  have hb := Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mp h_fw_dist_lt)))
  simp only [fiberwiseDistance, Set.image_univ, ← hg, mul_assoc, Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.sub_add_comm (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡)), ← Nat.sub_add_comm h_i_add_steps, Nat.add_sub_add_right] at hb
  refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f _ g.2) bot_le).trans_lt (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 ?_).trans_lt hb))
  conv_rhs => rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']; rhs; rw [← Finset.card_fin (2 ^ steps)]
  conv_rhs => rw [← Finset.card_product]
  refine Finset.card_le_card_of_surjOn (fun p => qMap_total_fiber _ _ _ _ (fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps) p.1 p.2) ?_
  intro x hx
  exact ⟨⟨_, _⟩, Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩, (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point _ _ i _ h_i_add_steps x _).mp rfl⟩

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P f f' cs P' y
  have : P' = Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs + Polynomial.C r_chal * oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs := by
    simp +zetaDelta only [ intermediateEvaluationPoly, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
      Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, Finset.mul_sum, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      add_mul, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  have hq k := Subtype.mk.inj
    ((generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.2 _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans
      (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap ..))
  simp +zetaDelta +decide only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
    ↓Polynomial.eval_C_mul, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, eval_comp, ↓←hq, this, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.2, Fin2ToF2,
    reduceIte, one_smul, zero_smul, zero_add,
    Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_basis, add_zero, normalizedWᵢ_eval_βᵢ_eq_1]
  ring1

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  have : Nonempty F := Zero.instNonempty
  apply Nat.le_induction
  · intro u hp
    simp only [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation, Nat.cast_one,
      ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hp
    rw [← show finMapTwoWords _ _ = u from List.ofFn_injective rfl]
    apply hC_proximityGapAffineLines
    rwa [← prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq]
  · intro n hn ih u hp
    apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA
    apply h_interleaved_gaps _ Nat.one_le_two_pow
    apply lt_of_le_of_lt' ?_ (prob_R_star_gt_threshold MC u e ?_)
    · apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
      intro r hr
      apply correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor MC ih u ⟨_, hr⟩
    · simp only [multilinearCombine_recursive_form] at hp
      rwa [← prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun]

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h⟩ := (Set.Finite.pi fun _ : Fin 4 => Set.finite_Icc B T).exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem
    $ by exact fun n k hk => hB $ n+k
  have key m : u (i+m) = u (j+m) := by
    clear hij
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on
    rename_i m ih
    by_cases hm : 4 ≤ m
    · apply @Int.cast_injective ℝ
      simp (disch := omega) only [hu, Nat.add_sub_assoc, ih]
    · exact congrFun h ⟨m, Nat.lt_of_not_ge hm⟩
  use i, j-i, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij
  intro n hn
  rw [← Nat.add_sub_cancel' hn, key, Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hij.le]

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  simp_all only [Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.not.symm]
  apply Nat.mul_left_cancel Nat.two_pos
  rw [mul_pow_sub_one Fintype.card_ne_zero, Fintype.card_set.symm, ← Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq hPP]
  clear hPP
  unfold Set.Intersecting
  grind

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  have swap (x y : _ → ℤ) i :
      digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then y j else x j) =
      digits_to_num x + (y i * 10 ^ i.1 - x i * 10 ^ i.1) := by
    subst digits_to_num
    rw [← sub_eq_iff_eq_add', ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [ite_mul, ite_sub, sub_self, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  intro d e f ⟨hd, he⟩
  simp only [hrelation, swap] at hd he
  have hs := Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hd.2 i)
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
